central_idea_and_construction: An original little jelly character as a mood-journal app identity. One pink asymmetrical mound with a sloped rounded top leaning gently left, two low rounded base feet formed from its own outline, no arms or ears. The left eye is one broad dark-plum oval half hidden by a slanting lid; right eye is a small simple upright oval. One tiny open curved mouth, calm and mildly amused. Expression comes from the unequal eyes and leftward lean; do not add cheeks, accessories, sparkle or another shape. Flat crisp color regions, coherent smooth contour, no gloss or 3D shading. Character fills about70% height and67% width, fully inside the square. Uniform saturated purple background edge-to-edge, enough tonal contrast to the pink body. No inset cream tile, mascot copied from another product, orange owl or stock ghost sheet.
small_size_signature: Leaning pink mound and asymmetric two-eye expression.
specific_risk: Very small expression can merge; verify dark eyes against the pink face.
reference_transfer: User negative references analyzed as text; no screenshot conditioning and no positive brand-copy reference.
observations: Recorded separately after viewing the native original.
